newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech ministry lowers GDP forecasts - paper.
newsitem.headline: Czech ministry lowers GDP forecasts - paper.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry has lowered its forecasts for real growth in gross domestic product (GDP) to 4.8 percent in 1996 and to 5.0 percent in 1997, the daily Hospodarske Noviny said on Monday.
The centre-right Czech government is committed to a balanced budget in 1996 and 1997 and its previous estimates for this year and next were 5.1 percent and 5.4 percent respectively.
However, Hospodarske Noviny said Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik saw no need to revise nominal GDP estimates and, therefore, the budget proposals would not need to be changed.
